title: Left-coefficient counit projection: transpose, unit and associativity
statement:
Use monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with associator $\alpha:(U\otimes V)\otimes W\to U\otimes(V\otimes W)$ and left unitor $\lambda$. A strong monoidal functor has the structure of [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor]; write $\delta^H_{U,V}:H(U\otimes V)\xrightarrow{\sim}HU\otimes HV$ and $e_H:H\mathbf1\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1$ for its inverse structure maps. Set $h^H_N=\lambda_N\circ(e_H\otimes1_N)$ and $a^H_{B,B',N}=\alpha_{HB,HB',N}\circ(\delta^H_{B,B'}\otimes1_N)$. Composition is right to left.
A symmetry $\beta_{U,V}:U\otimes V\xrightarrow{\sim}V\otimes U$ means natural involutive tensor swaps satisfying the hexagon identities with $\alpha$; a symmetric strong monoidal functor preserves these swaps under $\delta$.
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be symmetric monoidal categories and $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ a symmetric strong monoidal functor. Let $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be right adjoint to $F$, with natural Hom bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(FU,V)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(U,RV)$ and counit $\varepsilon_V:FRV\to V$ in the convention of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. For arbitrary $N\in\mathcal D$ and $B\in\mathcal C$, define $\rho_{N,B}:RN\otimes B\to R(N\otimes FB)$ as the adjunct of $(\varepsilon_N\otimes1_{FB})\circ\delta^F_{RN,B}$, and define
$$t_{B,N}=R(\beta_{N,FB})\circ\rho_{N,B}\circ\beta_{B,RN}:B\otimes RN\longrightarrow R(FB\otimes N).$$
Then $t$ is natural in both arguments, its transpose is exactly
$$\varepsilon_{FB\otimes N}\circ F(t_{B,N})=(1_{FB}\otimes\varepsilon_N)\circ\delta^F_{B,RN},$$
and for all $B,B'\in\mathcal C$ and $N\in\mathcal D$ it satisfies
$$R(h^F_N)\circ t_{\mathbf1,N}=\lambda_{RN},$$
$$R(a^F_{B,B',N})\circ t_{B\otimes B',N}=t_{B,FB'\otimes N}\circ(1_B\otimes t_{B',N})\circ\alpha_{B,B',RN}.$$
No component of $\rho$ or $t$ is assumed invertible.
